description: Build Ren'Py visual novels with script linting, automated tests, compilation, native launch and browser preview.
longDescription: Use Ren'Py's own SDK and .rpy sources. The plugin recognizes an existing game/options.rpy, creates a starter game, checks scripts with lint, compiles .rpyc, launches the native game, and builds a Ren'Py Web preview when Web support is installed in that SDK. Existing projects can also use a General workspace with the plugin enabled.
type.title: Ren'Py game
type.description: A native Ren'Py visual novel project; the browser Game panel uses a Ren'Py Web build.
config.renpySdkPath.description: Select the Ren'Py SDK directory containing renpy.py and renpy.sh, or renpy.sh itself. On Windows, select the SDK directory; the plugin uses its bundled Python interpreter. Leave empty to use RENPY_SDK_PATH or RENPY_HOME.
